title: JB MDL, NJ | Oil Water Separator Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR MOBILITY COMMAND > FA4484  87 CONS PK
description:
The purpose of this sources sought is to perform continued market research for the Oil Water Separator Services requirement for Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, New Jersey. We are gathering information for a future requirement. This is not a solicitation, questions will not be answered or responded to and offers are not being entertained or accepted at this time. If you are interested, please send an email of your company's capability statement to the contacts below. In the email or the capabilities statement, please include what small business designation your company is registered as. 

 NOTE: THERE ARE NOT FUNDS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME FOR THIS REQUIREMENT AND THIS POSTING IS 
FOR MARKET RESEARCH ONLY, AND IS NOT A SOLICITATION OR REQEST FOR PROPOSAL/QUOTE.
